findings.invariant_violated: Stability — same text element must read identically across legible moments absent a visible action
findings.description: At 0:00 the plate clearly reads 'STE097'; at 0:02 the same plate (partially cropped at frame bottom but with character tops sharp) reads 'STE197' — the fourth character has changed from '0' to '1'. No visible action (plate swap, cleaning, camera trick) explains the alteration; the camera is merely dollying toward the car.
